title: Cheesy Potato Tacos
description: A twist on traditional tacos, these cheesy potato tacos are a flavorful and satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: cheese
ingredients.notes: cheddar or Monterey Jack work well

instructions: In a large bowl, toss diced potatoes with 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil, 1 teaspoon of cumin, 1/2 teaspoon of chili powder, 1/4 teaspoon of salt, and 1/4 teaspoon of pepper until coated.
Spread potatoes on a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add taco seasoning packet and stir for 1 minute.
Add roasted potatoes to skillet and stir to coat with taco seasoning.
Warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble tacos by spooning potato mixture onto a tortilla and topping with shredded cheese, salsa, and sour cream (if using).
